subject: Next steps: vendor onboarding & procurement path for Nova Cloud
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novacloud.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & vendor onboarding checklist (Nova Cloud)

Hi Liam — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a couple of items we need to keep momentum on the commercial side: 

- Procurement path: from our discussion it sounded like Nova Cloud prefers standard PO terms but may want a marketplace listing later. Can you confirm whether Finance will require a PO now or whether a corporate card purchase is an option for initial POC spend?
- Vendor docs: attached is our standard vendor packet. We typically need a completed vendor intake, a signed W-9 (for US entities) or W-8 (if applicable), and banking details for ACH.
- Timing: if procurement can return the intake + W-9 by next Wed (5/25) we can scope a dedicated capacity quote and lock pricing for the quarter.
- Next steps: Camila -> finalize quote & SOW after intake; Liam -> confirm PO vs card and upload intake; Ben -> loop in contract ops if any non-standard terms are needed.

Attachments: [redwood_vendor_packet.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if that's easier.

Camila Reyes
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0127
www.redwood.ai

---
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novacloud.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novacloud.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & vendor onboarding checklist (Nova Cloud)

Camila — thanks for the summary. Quick answers from our side: 

- Procurement path: Finance prefers a PO for any recurring spend > $5k/month. For the POC (targeting ~$2k) we can do a corporate card to get started; however, we'll open a PO request now in parallel so the long-term path is aligned.
- Vendor docs: attaching the intake filled by our procurement coordinator and a signed W-9. Banking details redacted in this email; procurement will upload to your vendor portal per your instructions.
- Marketplace: Marketplace listing would be valuable long-term; not required for the POC. We'll evaluate once technical validation completes.

Attachments: [nova_vendor_intake_filled.pdf (PDF, 86KB), W-9_Novacloud_signed.pdf (PDF, 45KB)]

I'll ask procurement to start the PO and to use the vendor portal link if you can resend it.

—Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform Partnerships | Nova Cloud
liam.oconnor@novacloud.com | +1 617-555-8890

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround, Liam. Next items on our side: 

- I'll prepare the POC order form and SOW for signature and send via DocuSign once the vendor intake + W-9 are uploaded.
- Ben will confirm the portal invite (Ben: please push to procurement@novacloud.com).
- Marissa will include the PO instructions and bill-to details for Finance.

If procurement can upload banking info into the portal and open the PO ticket by Friday (5/21), we should be able to kick off the POC week of 5/24. 

Thanks everyone — scheduling a 15-min sync on Friday at 10:30am PT to confirm PO status. Invite to follow.
